WQ0 = W['blocks.0.attn.W_Q'][0]  # (20, 5)
WK0 = W['blocks.0.attn.W_K'][0]  # (20, 5)
bQ0 = W['blocks.0.attn.b_Q'][0]  # (5,)
bK0 = W['blocks.0.attn.b_K'][0]  # (5,)

# Compute QK attention logits from positional embeddings only
# Q = pos @ WQ + bQ, K = pos @ WK + bK
Q_pos0 = W_pos @ WQ0 + bQ0  # (10, 5)
K_pos0 = W_pos @ WK0 + bK0  # (10, 5)
attn_logits_pos_L0H0 = Q_pos0 @ K_pos0.T / np.sqrt(5)  # (10, 10)
attn_weights_L0H0 = np.exp(attn_logits_pos_L0H0) / np.exp(attn_logits_pos_L0H0).sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)

print("=== L0H0 Positional Attention Pattern (rows=query, cols=key) ===")

    for p2 in range(p1+1, 5):
        sim = cosine_sim(baseline['L1_MLP'][0][p1], baseline['L1_MLP'][0][p2])
        print(f"  pos{p1} vs pos{p2}: {sim:.4f}")

# Summary of ablation effects
